# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 39,975 across 2 platforms (youtube: 34,422, instagram: 5,553).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-08-30.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.3%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.0%.
- youtube: positive 63.3%, neutral 21.1%, negative 15.6%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.494, neutral 0.494, positive 0.505 (spread 0.011).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: new, agent, think, real - 20,310 posts.
- T5: business, help, digitalmarketing, brand - 4,888 posts.
- T10: easy, understand, easy understand, simple - 1,522 posts.
- T8: time, save, save time, real time - 1,381 posts.
- T7: smart, rich, broke, dumb - 1,200 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: new, agent, think, real (+1.93 pts).
- Rising: T10: easy, understand, easy understand, simple (+0.71 pts).
- Rising: T9: clear, explaining, clearly, clearly clear (+0.56 pts).
- Declining: T8: time, save, save time, real time (-0.34 pts).
- Declining: T5: business, help, digitalmarketing, brand (-4.36 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 7,195 posts.
- AI Agents - 5,480 posts.
- Automation - 4,351 posts.
- Startup - 4,099 posts.
- Digital Marketing - 3,150 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=11, UMass coherence -0.6687 (more coherent than LDA).
